hero.subtitle: Immerse yourself in imperial Indian spices, traditional Arabian Mandi & charcoal grills, and zesty Indo-Chinese culinary wonders crafted with royal passion.

about.title: Welcome to IMPERIUM
about.p1: Named after the Latin for supreme sovereignty, IMPERIUM Restaurant brings regal hospitality and unforgettable flavours to the heart of Qatar. Situated in the vibrant Al Rayyan district, our kitchen is a tribute to gastronomic excellence.
about.p2: From the smoky embers of our charcoal grill pits to slow-cooked claypot dum biryanis and wok-flamed Indo-Chinese delicacies, every recipe is honed by master chefs using premium halal meats and freshly ground whole spices.
about.highlight1Desc: Fragrant aged basmati slow-dum cooked with pure saffron, marinated tender cuts and ghee.
about.highlight2Desc: Succulent seafood and spiced meats char-grilled to perfection over real smoking embers.
about.highlight3Desc: High-flame wok sensations packed with crisp vegetables, prawns, and zesty house sauces.
